summary: Sustain-heavy bruiser who poke-trades with three-part Q swings and heals off every hit. His damage is in the Q sweet spots, the edges of each swing, so dodging those (or getting inside them) wins trades. Anti-heal and true damage blunt him.
threats: Q (The Darkin Blade) is cast three times; each sweet spot (the outer edge) deals bonus damage and knocks up.
W (Infernal Chains) slows you, then pulls you back to the centre if you haven't walked out in time.
E (Umbral Dash) repositions him between Q casts, so the sweet spots move.
R (World Ender) at 5 boosts his healing and damage. Fighting him while it's active is a losing trade.

matchups.why: Riposte parries one of Aatrox's Q knockups and stuns him back, breaking his combo. Vitals deal true damage his healing struggles to keep up with, and Fiora's Lunge lets her dodge Q sweet spots by dashing inside them.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for his second or third Q; a parried knockup stuns him mid-combo.
Lunge (Q) inside his Q sweet spot rather than away from it; the centre does far less damage.
Walk out of W (Infernal Chains) immediately so you don't get pulled back into Q3.
Trade on vitals when his Q is on cooldown; he has almost no damage without it.
matchups.early: Even at level 1, then favored. Trade when his Q is on cooldown and deny the poke-heal pattern he wants.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R boosts his healing. Don't fight into it; back off and re-engage once it ends, then use your R heal zone.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and fight in his cooldown windows; avoid trading near his minions, where he heals more.
matchups.jungle: His only escape is E. Gank once he's used it to reposition for a Q.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Anti-heal item early (Executioner's-style) plus armor boots.
matchups.remember: Parry the knockup, get inside the sweet spot.

matchups.why: Irelia's Q dashes let her dodge Aatrox's Q sweet spots by stepping inside or through them, and her extended-fight damage at max passive outpaces his healing. His W chain is easy to break with a dash.
trading: Q (Bladesurge) through a minion to dodge his Q sweet spot as it lands.
Land E (Flawless Duet) after he commits his Q so he can't knock you up while you're stunned.
Dash out of his W chain before it pulls you back.
Fight only with 3+ passive stacks; without them, his poke heals out-trade you.
matchups.early: Even at levels 1–3. Build passive stacks on the wave and trade when his Q is on cooldown.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R heals him through extended fights; back off and use your R to slow him once it ends.
matchups.wave: Keep low-HP minions near him so you have dash targets; avoid fighting with no minions around.
matchups.jungle: He's gankable after he's used E. Your E stun sets up the kill.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Anti-heal and bruiser items; armor boots.

matchups.why: Both are sustain bruisers with outer-edge sweet spots. Darius wins if he pulls Aatrox in and stacks Hemorrhage, but Aatrox's Q knockups interrupt Darius's combo and his healing out-sustains long poke trades.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him after he's used Q, so he can't knock you up mid-combo.
Walk inside his Q sweet spots rather than away from them.
Hit the outer edge of your own Q on him to heal through his poke.
Don't trade into his R; back off and re-engage once it ends.
matchups.early: Even. Trade when his Q is on cooldown and you can stack Hemorrhage freely.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R out-heals you in extended fights; your R execute is strongest right after his R ends.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade on his cooldown windows; don't fight in his full wave.
matchups.jungle: He escapes with E. Gank once he's used it.
matchups.remember: Pull after his Q, execute after his R.

matchups.why: Aatrox's Q poke punishes Nasus every time he walks up to stack, and his healing out-sustains Nasus's short trades. Nasus can only farm safely and outscale with items and stacks.
trading: W (Wither) him as he starts his Q combo to slow his repositioning.
Stack Q on minions only when his Q is on cooldown.
Walk inside his Q sweet spots rather than away from them.
Walk out of his W chain immediately so you aren't pulled back.
matchups.early: Give up contested creeps and farm under tower; don't stand in his Q range.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives HP and resists to survive his R all-in; use it defensively.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower; stack Q on cannon minions.
matchups.jungle: Ask for an early gank when he overextends without E.
matchups.build: Grasp. Armor boots and an early anti-heal item.
